notes:
Founder-led discovery call. Founder: Maya Thompson (CEO). Small team (3 engineers). Inbound self-serve signup then booked call.

Call highlights:
- Wants simple pricing breakdown: per-token examples, 100k vs 1M tokens, comparison to OpenAI/Anthropic pricing and latency. Quote: 'I need to know how this scales cost-wise before committing to building on it.'
- Primary workload: chat widget for SMB websites + support assistant that suggests replies; also exploring summarization for long threads.
- Latency expectations: page-load/response < 600ms for short chat turns; happy to batch for longer ops. Throughput low initially (~10-50 reqs/min).
- Cost sensitivity: high. Founder is price-shopping; currently prototyping on OpenAI and Anthropic. Wants to know break-even points where Redwood hosted API becomes more economical.
- Model preferences: wants access to Open weights or comparable LLMs; asks about model catalog, Redwood-verified perf profiles. Concerned about hallucination on support replies.
- Routing/fallback: would like fallback to cheaper model for non-critical responses and higher-quality model for purchase flows.
- Security: needs SOC2 + SSO eventually, audit logs. Data residency not a blocker now.
- Upsell path: if traction, will move to Dedicated/reserved capacity in 6-12 months; wants info on migration path.

Action items from call:
- I (Jordan) will send pricing comparison deck + simple cost calculator CSV and sample request cost table. (sent 2026-02-14, drive link above)
- SE (Alex) to prepare short tech notes on model parity and latency expectations vs OpenAI/Anthropic; include streaming + tokenization notes.
- Offer 1-month POC credits and self-serve guide to onboard.

Quotes/remarks: 'If the per-token math looks better than OpenAI, we can flip a switch and move fast.'
